mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park, a Waxing Gibbous moon, and a moderate air quality index of 61. Expect an overnight low of 49 degrees with no rain forecasted. Tonight, you can spot the ISS rising near Cross Plains and traveling toward Madison, remaining low on the horizon.

The City of Verona is preparing for a Plan Commission meeting on November 4th to discuss various projects, including the Ardent Glen final plat and site plans for 1979 Milky Way. Residents should also note that property tax bills will be mailed no later than December 15th.

There is plenty to do in Verona. Today, enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360, or Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow, catch live music at Bailey's Run or Lake Lou-ee, and plan for the Dane County Farmers' Market this Saturday.

On October 15th, the Verona Police Department responded to a report of dangerous driving and arrested a school bus driver for O W I. No injuries were reported, and the department is currently investigating the incident.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. Culver's is currently open, but please note they will be closing their doors in 50 minutes, so make sure to get there soon.
